definitions.registration_transaction: One row in the JPJ source. It is not a sale, a purchase, or a customer.
definitions.electric: is_electric is 1 when fuel is electric.
definitions.hybrid: is_hybrid is 1 when fuel is hybrid_petrol or hybrid_diesel. Those two categories remain separate.
definitions.registration_share: Registrations in a group divided by all recorded registrations in the same period.
definitions.rakan_niaga: A JPJ partner registration channel. It is not a geographic state.
definitions.partial_year: The latest year is partial when its maximum date_reg is before 31 December. Full-year change is withheld. The like-for-like view compares January through the last complete month.

limitations: Registration transactions are not vehicle sales, purchases, or a direct measure of demand.
date_reg may differ from a purchase date.
The latest year is partial when it ends before 31 December. Full-year change for that year is null.
Rakan Niaga is not geographic state data and is not assigned to a state.
Unknown, other, and the source fuel categories are retained. Fuel categories are not merged.
Registration counts alone do not support a causal conclusion, including for months with unusually low counts.
